chat.said: Our bike repair workshop turns away about 12 repair jobs a week because both mechanics are fully booked. We want the average wait for a repair under 5 days by the end of March, and we can't spend more than £1,500 a month extra. We could hire a part-time mechanic for about £1,300 a month, open on Sundays, or stop taking e-bike jobs, which take roughly twice as long as ordinary ones. Jo thinks Sunday opening would only spread the same work over more days. The average wait is about 9 days now.

It rests on Olumi's what-if ranges for 'Mechanic hours available per week changed: Hire a part-time mechanic' (12 to 20 hours/week), 'Effect of each extra hours/week on average wait for a repair' (−0.4 to −0.1 days weeks/hours). It reads their approximate 'Current average wait for a repair' as 10% either way, 8 times in 10, until they give a range.

pre_mortem.question: Imagine it is a year from now and this has failed. What went wrong? Write each reason you can think of, in your own words.
pre_mortem.after: Olumi's stories are shown after yours, marked as Olumi's. Yours stay yours.
pre_mortem.held_text: Olumi's reply about how this could fail is shown once you have written your own reasons it could fail, or chosen to see Olumi's now.

lens_words.needsRun: Run the analysis to see what would change it.

hint.full: The model as you built it
hint.tradeoffs: What each option gains and gives up, along the links in your model
hint.rests_on: Every figure the model rests on, and who it came from
hint.premortem: Ways each option could fail, imagined by Olumi
hint.what_changes: What the last Run is most sensitive to
hint.what_if: Try a different value and see each option beside the saved model. Nothing is saved.

lens_words.rests_on_label: Rests on, 3 to check or set

team_words.failed: That did not go through. Nothing was saved.

evidence.sourcePlaceholder: A link, or a plain note of where
evidence.sharedNote: Shared with the team as soon as you add it. It does not change the model.

views.held: Give or skip your own view first: the others’ views show here once you have.
views.private: Private to you until everyone’s views are revealed
views.shareTitle: Shows this view to the team now, before the others are revealed. Olumi does not read it until then.
views.skip: I would rather not answer this
